verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents an LLM inference story for the H200: up to 2X faster than H100 on Llama2, 1.9X on Llama2 70B, 1.6X on GPT-3 175B, and NIM inference microservices via AI Enterprise. TensorRT-LLM is mentioned for data-center DeepSeek deployment, but not tied explicitly to this part, and the evidence never mentions low-precision formats. Missing for 10: documented FP8/FP4 precision support for H200, explicit H200 support for TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp, and independent hands-on inference corroboration.
